scripts.build: npm run rules:check && npm run typecheck && npm --prefix functions run build && vite build
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-choice-arena --only firestore "vitest run tests/firestore.test.ts tests/service.test.ts"
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-choice-arena --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.test:auth: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-choice-arena --only auth,firestore,functions "playwright test --config playwright.auth.config.ts"
scripts.test:game: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-choice-arena --only auth,firestore,functions "playwright test --config playwright.game.config.ts"
